chapter: Memphis, Oklahoma, the Kirk band and Kansas City
title: The band's territory and how Kansas City became its base
summary: The band toured Oklahoma, Arkansas and the Midwest, with Tulsa in summer. Kansas City became its base after the Playmore job, about two years after John joined.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: How wide an area did the band cover then?

All through Oklahoma, even to Mississippi, Arkansas, and Colorado. Let's see; they went even to as far as - we didn't go all the way to California then, but we went some peculiar places that I never dreamed of being: Peoria, Illinois - just little small towns, you know.
At this time where was your home base, in Oklahoma City?
Do you mean the state or the city?
No, the city, the city of Oklahoma. We worked in Tulsa maybe 3 or 4 months during the summer season and then we'd go back to Oklahoma.
When did the band get into Kansas City?

The band got into Kansas City I think about 2 years after John Williams joined it. There was an opening at the Playmore there in Kansas, I think it was the Playmore, and Andy decided to go there. After that Kansas City became the headquarters for the band.
